22:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: CFP Rankings Show
The reveal of the top 25 college football teams, as chosen by the College Football Playoff Selection Committee.

22:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Basketball
The No. 17 Kansas Jayhawks face the No. 23 Kentucky Wildcats for an NCAA Division I game. Kansas rides a two-game win streak alongside guard Tre White, and Kentucky rides a two-game win streak alongside forward Milan Momcilovic in Chicago, Illinois.
